notes.title: New Release Date
notes.content:
Moving to October to fix issues and Expand! I will also work on better ways to talk with you guys. I withdrew Maid of Venia from the Summer next fest and opted for the fall next fest and the game will now release sometime in October. 

Things I want to fix or improve

-The mini-map
-Shading, I am working on making things more uniform 
-Fix the weather system issues
-Fix the cutscenes or improve them (We have an artist joining us to help fix/replace the AI art, only a few cutscenes use AI and some could still but it just depends on what we can get done. The world is huge and will have story everywhere)
-keep working on skills and weapons, improving existing and adding more.
-Building the world with more unique features
-Fixing animations!
-Adding new community characters and a song

We have had a few people reach out about becoming part of the story and I will keep that open for now. I will post updates on the characters as I add them this summer.

I have been fixing and expanding [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3522700/Path_of_the_Ory/]Path of the Ory[/url]

After playing through everything and having a little heart to heart with myself, I realized how much love my games need and I decided to fix and expand both games. Thank you guys so much for your support. I will be releasing the Path of the Ory soundtrack soon.

New ending in Path of the Ory connects the games even more and brings our main character, Kayla the Ory, to Maid of Venia!

Next update will be big an sometime in June!

notes.title: Become an NPC
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I’m opening the gates of Venia to YOU.

Whether you’re one of our awesome Steam community members or a backer of the Kickstarter, I’d love to offer you a unique opportunity—become a character in the world of Maid of Venia.

You can be:

A Minusculian (tiny, mischievous beings)

A Mud-Dwarf or Mud-Elf from the deep caves of Venor

A mythical figure from a forgotten age, spoken of only in hushed tones by other NPCs

A villager, warrior, merchant, or ghost

Or something entirely your own—this is your story too!

We’re already building heartfelt cameos for people I love—Clark, who inspired so much of this world, Ruth, my niece, and my boys, who each have their own corner of Venia being crafted. Now I’d love to add you (or someone meaningful to you) into the game.

Whether you want a named character, a statue, a piece of lore, or a quiet NPC who says something small but powerful—it’s all possible.

📝 Just comment below, [url=https://starvinglamagames.com/]email[/url] me or message me with:

The name you’d like to use

Any character type or idea you have (or let me surprise you!)

Let’s make Maid of Venia a living world full of real souls.
Thanks for being part of this journey.

💛 – William (Starving Lama Games)

notes.title: Skill/Weather Update

I added over 30 new skills total. Each character has 31 skills now, including three of the fast travel skills. More fast travel after the demo.

I am adding in two new races, the Minisculians- a race of humans, elves, and even goblins and other creatures shrunk by the Dark Lords magic (they don't have collision or animations currently). And the Nemorai-from “numen” (divine presence) They are demi-gods.

Namesake Day is coming to Thistledown but I am still finishing the story missions and cutscenes, working in quests and animations. Venor's Peak is now tied to Thistledown and then Thistledown is connected to the Great Plains.

I am working the new weather system and had to do a complete change to the lighting, the lighting is now linear which helps the weather function better but I am having to fix a few things including indoor lighting and a few backend issues but I think I have it working and just need to adjust it now.

I am still working the skills in and already found 1 issue with the High Elf's Arrow, it is not there but instead we have a copy of Arrow Scourge, I will fix that right away. I also have about 10 more skills a piece planned including a Demon summon.

notes.title: Small update More this weekend
notes.content:
I just posted a small update and will have a bigger update this weekend. I am backing the build up before adding in the new cutscenes and levels for the story missions that will be a part of the demo levels. The demo will be Venor's Peak, Thistledown and Elderbrook. I will be building out those levels first, while adding skill and a level increase. New weapons with story attached. If you haven't tried the weapons in Thistledown, two of them are about to vanish until DLC that will release later. 

Map- still not set on the map. I bought a software, profantasy, that is entirely devoted to map building for games. I built a map for Thistle down last night that was great but some of my map had major issues and so does the Venor's Peak map. So I tested something new in Thistledown and created icons to mark sections of the map and then fixed the edges of the map to not overlap other art. Let me know what you think.

I will try to figure out more of Steam community and added more people to the chat. I would love your feedback. 

Story will go into how *spoiler for Path of the Ory end* monsters came to Venia from the hearts of man. Beasts, gods, giants and all manner of creature lived in Venia before the Dark lords started opening the gates to human desires that all hell broke lose. Quite literally, this is when fallen angels and demons first come to Venia. 300 years later humans are starting to expand again. After monsters drove humans from land they had claimed from the elves, the elves-who had no fear of monsters, moved back to the ancient shores of Thistledown and replaced the human name. More of that and the Fan and more with the next update this weekend. 

Maid of Venia and Path of the Ory are both done in a "Champloo" style. Meaning "mash up" and "make up as you go." I loved Samurai Champloo growing up. I loved the way it mashed hip hop with a samurai story and I love that they were constantly improvising. This is how I make music, how I write and how Maid of Venia is being developed. A mash-up and sometimes messy. Thank you guys for joining me!

notes.title: Mini-Map
notes.content:
Working on Mini-Map and music with an example of how music was made for the game. The Map is working! I created a 2d illustration of Venor's Peak and blew it up to 12,000 by 12,000 pixels and then placed it under the level, set on the Minimap Only layer I created, moved all unneeded art off the map layer and on to my default gameplay layer. All games, even 3d games have layers. Still working on it but this is just after the first attempt. 

[url=https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_k2DOl5Ld5bbetxSLFO-bJsKjx99xtG3xA&si=8OrQKQqCEgJpLH_P]Check out Arionis[/url], the band that Clark and I were in back in Highschool. The world of Venia was created back then. I actually made a comic and pitched it to Dark Horse but never heard anything back. 

After highschool I toured with a band named [url=https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_mj8ID4YLY7T1bN4S15HxMsqb0_PhK8Gok&si=1R8nWpV28ifZdvTH]Kings of Metropolis[/url]

[url=https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=4-y-E5HG8aY&si=Kbqd1nPstyY75jcR]Here was us live at WorkPlay in Birmingham[/url]. I am the front man, but also played bass on the recordings and engineered the album for Kings of Metropolis.

I played guitar, drums, bass and vocals depending on the song. I am not the best singer but some of the other vocals are me. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3522700/Path_of_the_Ory/]I just posted a video showing me record a guitar part and getting Suno to finish the song.[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622420/Jackroid/]Jackroid is coming next month for free to thank you guys for all of the support.[/url]

notes.title: New Weapons!
notes.content:
New Weapons!
New Weapons and weapon pickups, item pickup art and working on making the icons better. you can test all of the weapons in Thistledown. I would test them now bc in the future you will have to work harder to get them, quest, hunt and search for them. The Demo will be Venor's Peak, Thistledown, and Elderbrook. I am working on one extra story mission in Elderbrook and two to three in Thistledown.

Added
Pickups for
-Iron Sword
-Steel Sword
-Holy Sword
-Sword of Draco
-Starlight
-Eclipse Staff
-Crystal/Rune Staff
-Fan of Wind
-Bow
-Hunting Bow
-War Bow

Upgraded UI aspects in game. Working on Start menu next.

Added skills
- Starlight
-Wind of a Fan
- Griffin Summon

added new fx

everything is being developed. Most of the world is a void!

You can summon the Griffin if you are the Fire mage and at least level 2 or above. The icon is the wolf, still working on creating icons for everything. The griffin will be one of many extra summons coming to help expand the level cap to 30! I will also add fallen angel summons, dragons, golems and more. we will also do some skill crossover in the later levels, like healing and summoning. I am also working on a way to use a spell book to summon a monster to do a single attack. The spell books would be used as weapons and you would essentially just summon an attack like you would magic, call the bullet prefab - call this time the monster animation. I could also have it so that when you get the book out the monster is on top and ready to cast.

The sword of Draco and Starlight are part of a DLC that is planned for the future and promised as a kickstarter tier, so if you want to try either out then head to Thistledown.

I will be finalizing the two main demo levels and building skills, and adjust skill unlock tier, through level 20. Fixing art and menus and I will try to get controller support added before the demo is up. I plan to be ready by the end of April. Wish me luck!

notes.title: You could lose your save! New stuff and new broken stuff!
notes.content: Before you update know that I had to recreate the characters to make the new art work. I named everything the same but no promises that if you had a save you won't lose it. I added the new character art but broke the mount or at least where you ride and dismount you have to jump to change animation, or attack, basically the animation is getting stuck. This also happens with my newer monsters that have multiple walk animations. I am working on that as well as getting all of the new npc art in which you can see in Sunvale. Please enjoy! I am really tired and about to get some sleep after working through the night. Added - Fallen angels, Griffins, The dragons - Elder and Othello, A poison ice golem, and more enemies. Most have standard stats as I am just testing them and thought you guys would like to check them out. I have not begun to adjust leveling yet, so you can level rather quickly.
